project_description.value: A-E professional services task to develop an updated tri-service Unified Facilities Guide Specification (UFGS 23 82 00) for Terminal Heating Units. The work merges NAVFAC Navy UFGS-23 80 20.00 10 (Gas-Fired Heating Equipment), Army UFGS-23 82 00.00 20 (Terminal Heating Units), and Army UFGS-23 83 00.00 20 (Electric Space Heating Equipment) into a unified tri-service specification. Deliverables include the revised UFGS, a cross-reference comparison matrix, CCR (Criteria Change Request) resolutions, and facilitated review meetings.
project_description.quote: This project consists of all work necessary to develop the task. The final product will serve as design/construction document for facility designers/contractors.
